latin: Dato quocunque obiecto practicabili, nobilior est operatio quae eum practicat quam quae eum contemplatur, si caetera sint paria.
translation: For any object capable of being acted on, all else being equal, the operation that acts on it outranks the operation that merely contemplates it.
